title: SFN helpers accept non-octet and non-integer protocol inputs
description: python/src/lichen/timing/sfn.py hash_32/slot_for only check len(eui64), so bytearray/list inputs and non-octet integer sequences can be hashed; sfn_delta performs bitwise arithmetic without exact-int validation and accepts booleans as counters. Protocol-facing helpers should require exact bytes for EUI-64 and exact integers for u32 counters/slot counts, normalize documented out-of-range SFNs only after type validation, and test bool/float/list/bytearray inputs.
